question: When did the Third Anglo-Maratha War take place?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1817-19**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Third Anglo-Maratha War took place between **1817 and 1819**.
 
• This war marked the final and decisive conflict between the **British East India Company** and the Maratha Empire.
 
• The British emerged victorious, leading to the **annexation of the Maratha territories** into the British Empire.
 
• The war effectively ended the Maratha Empire and led to the establishment of British dominance over most of India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Anglo-Maratha Wars**

 
 
• The Anglo-Maratha Wars were a series of conflicts between the British East India Company and the Maratha Empire in India. There were three major wars.
 
• The First Anglo-Maratha War (1775-1782) ended with the Treaty of Salbai, establishing a fragile peace.
 
• The Second Anglo-Maratha War (1803-1805) resulted in British victory and significant territorial gains for the British.
 
• The Third Anglo-Maratha War (1817-1819) was the final conflict, leading to the dissolution of the Maratha Empire and the establishment of British control over most of India.
 
 
 
• **British East India Company**
 
 
• The British East India Company was a private company granted a royal charter by Queen Elizabeth I in 1600.
 
 
• **Maratha Empire**
 
 
• The Maratha Empire was a powerful Indian state that existed from the late 17th century to the early 19th century.
 
• It was founded by Shivaji Maharaj and became one of the major political powers in India.
 
• The empire controlled large parts of India and was known for its military prowess and administrative efficiency.
